name: Wu Xu
bio: Received a Master's degree in Bioinformatics and Computational Biology and a Ph.D. in Genetics/Biochemistry from Iowa State University, followed by postdoctoral training in the Department of Biochemistry at St. Jude Children's Hospital. Dr. Xu's research interest is understanding protein function and structure relation in the context of signal transduction using a combination of experimental and computational approaches, focusing on the molecular mechanism of electron transfer in photosystem I and on developing the TSR-based computational method for probing molecular interactions.

name: Vijay Raghavan
bio: Received a BTech in mechanical engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology, Madras, an MBA from McMaster University, and a PhD in computing science from the University of Alberta. He is Professor Emeritus of computer science with the Center for Advanced Computer Studies, UL Lafayette, was Director of the Center for Visual and Decision Informatics (2012–2023), and is Co-Director of the Laboratory for Internet Computing. His research interests include information retrieval and extraction, data and web mining, multimedia retrieval, data integration, and link discovery.
